content:
[Idea] Introduce "instant teleport" currency as an alternative to logout macro
Idea:

- Add a currency item which instantly teleports to the town and can be placed in a skill toolbar.
- Make it relatively rare - not as rare as exalt, somewhere around divine.
- Give 1 or 2 as a quest reward.

This way people won't have to use logout macro, as currently, it feels like cheating the game. Besides that, each "instant logout" will cost some currency.
